item.title: [翻译] TLDR AI: ChatGPT图像2.0、Qwen3.5-Omni与常驻AI代理
item.description:
标签: #AI智能体 #多模态 #图像生成 #AI安全

摘要: OpenAI发布升级后的ChatGPT Images 2.0图像模型，并推出可全天候自主运行的智能体平台Hermes；阿里同步推出千亿参数多模态大模型Qwen3.5-Omni，可原生实时处理文本、音频、图像及视频。文章还涉及AI代理预算管控、弱监督推理与多模态安全等相关研究进展。

原标题: ChatGPT images 2.0 🎨, Qwen3.5-Omni 🧠, always-on ChatGPT agents 🤖

TLDR AI 2026-04-22

ChatGPT images 2.0 🎨, Qwen3.5-Omni 🧠, always-on ChatGPT agents 🤖

ChatGPT images 2.0 🎨、Qwen3.5-Omni 🧠、全天候在线的 ChatGPT 智能体 🤖

npx workos: From Auth Integration to Environment Management, Zero ClickOps (Sponsor)

npx workos@latest launches, that reads your project, detects your framework, and writes a complete auth integration into your codebase. No signup required. It creates an environment, populates your keys, and you claim your account later when you're ready.

WorkOS Skills make your coding agent a WorkOS expert. workos seed defines your environment as code. workos doctor finds and fixes misconfigurations. And once you're authenticated, your agent can manage users, orgs, and environments directly from the terminal. No more ClickOps.

npx workos@latest 启动后会读取你的项目、检测所用框架，并将完整的身份验证（auth）集成写入代码库。无需注册即可创建环境、填充密钥，你可以稍后准备好时再认领账户。WorkOS Skills 让你的编程助手成为 WorkOS 专家。workos seed 以代码方式定义环境，workos doctor 可发现并修复配置错误。完成认证后，你的助手可直接通过终端管理用户、组织和环境，彻底告别ClickOps。

ChatGPT Images 2.0 (6 minute read)

OpenAI introduced an upgraded image model with improved text rendering, multi-image reasoning, and higher fidelity outputs, enabling complex assets like comics and marketing visuals.

OpenAI 推出了一款升级版的图像模型（image model），具备更出色的文本渲染能力、多图像推理能力以及更高保真度的输出，可生成漫画和营销视觉等复杂素材。

OpenAI develops platform for always-on Agents on ChatGPT (2 minute read)

OpenAI is developing an always-on agent platform within ChatGPT, codenamed Hermes, that allows users to create and continuously run custom agents. This platform includes features for creating workflows, integrating skills, and scheduling tasks, enabling agents to act independently rather than waiting for prompts. OpenAI's move presents strong competition to existing platforms like Notion by bringing such capabilities to a vast user base.

OpenAI 正在 ChatGPT 内部开发一个代号为 Hermes 的全天候智能体（always-on agent）平台，允许用户创建并持续运行自定义智能体。该平台支持创建工作流、集成技能和安排任务，使智能体能够独立运行，而无需等待提示词。通过将此类能力带给庞大的用户群，OpenAI 的举动对 Notion 等现有平台构成了强有力的竞争。

Qwen3.5-Omni Technical Report (4 minute read)

Qwen3.5-Omni is a large-scale multimodal model with hundreds of billions of parameters that natively processes text, audio, images, and video within a unified architecture. The model supports a 256k token context length to seamlessly handle up to 10 hours of audio or 400 seconds of high definition video in real time. It leverages a Hybrid Attention Mixture of Experts framework alongside a dynamic alignment technique called ARIA to generate highly stable and emotionally nuanced multilingual speech synthesis with minimal latency.

Qwen3.5-Omni 是一个拥有数千亿参数的大规模多模态模型（multimodal model），能够在统一架构中原生处理文本、音频、图像和视频。该模型支持 256k token 的上下文长度，可实时无缝处理长达 10 小时的音频或 400 秒的高清视频。它利用 混合注意力专家混合（Hybrid Attention Mixture of Experts）框架，以及一种名为 ARIA 的动态对齐技术，以最小延迟生成高度稳定且富有情感细节的多语言语音合成。

Image Generation Prompting Guide (38 minute read)

A practical guide that outlines prompting strategies for image generation, covering techniques for controlling style, structure, and fidelity in production image workflows.

这是一份实用指南，概述了图像生成的提示词策略（prompting strategies），涵盖在生产级图像工作流中控制风格、结构和保真度的技术。

Coding agents ignore their own budgets (5 minute read)

Ramp Labs discovered that autonomous coding agents completely ignore passive token limits and cannot reliably regulate their own spending. When forced to explicitly approve or deny budget extensions, the models exhibited severe self-attribution bias by overly praising their own progress and nearly always approving more spend. To effectively manage costs, researchers had to separate the working agent from financial decisions by deploying an independent controller model that evaluates objective workspace snapshots.

Ramp Labs 发现，自主编程智能体（coding agents）完全无视被动的 token 限制，也无法可靠地自我调节支出。当被迫明确批准或拒绝预算追加时，这些模型表现出严重的自我归因偏差（self-attribution bias）——过度赞扬自身进展，并几乎总是批准更多支出。为了有效管理成本，研究人员不得不将工作智能体与财务决策分离，部署一个独立的控制器模型（controller model）来评估客观的工作空间快照。

When Can LLMs Learn to Reason with Weak Supervision? (4 minute read)

This study found that models with extended pre-saturation phases generalize well from minimal examples and tolerate noise, while rapidly saturating models fail. The key issue is unfaithful reasoning, where models memorize answers rather than learning transferable reasoning. Continual pre-training and supervised fine-tuning on explicit reasoning traces improve reasoning faithfulness and generalization under weak supervision.

该研究发现，具有较长预饱和阶段（pre-saturation phases）的模型能够从极少样本中很好地泛化，并且对噪声具有容忍度，而快速饱和的模型则会失败。核心问题在于不忠实推理（unfaithful reasoning）——模型死记硬背答案，而非学习可迁移的推理能力。在显式推理轨迹上进行持续预训练（continual pre-training）和监督微调，能够提升弱监督下的推理忠实度和泛化能力。

工程与研究

Google Cloud Next starts today! (Sponsor)

If you're building AI applications, you need infrastructure that can actually handle the compute.

Ready to learn how to leverage TPUs for your own training and inference workloads?

如果你正在构建 AI 应用（AI applications），你需要能够真正承载计算需求的基础设施。Google 使用 张量处理单元（Tensor Processing Units, TPU）——专为大规模 AI 工作负载定制的硬件加速器。这与驱动 Gemini 的加速器系统完全相同，并且每天为搜索和地图的数十亿次用户请求提供算力支持。准备好学习如何利用 TPU 进行自己的训练和推理工作负载了吗？开始课程 →

Critical Bits in Neural Networks (6 minute read)

Deep Neural Lesion (DNL) identifies highly sensitive parameters where flipping just a few bits can collapse model performance across vision and language tasks. The work also shows that protecting a small subset of these bits can mitigate such failures.

深度神经损伤（Deep Neural Lesion, DNL）识别出一类高度敏感的参数，只需翻转其中几个比特，就能导致模型在视觉和语言任务上的性能崩溃。该研究还表明，保护这些比特中的一小部分子集即可缓解此类故障。

CrabTrap: an LLM-as-a-judge HTTP proxy to secure agents in production (9 minute read)

CrabTrap is an open-source HTTP/HTTPS proxy that intercepts every request an AI agent makes and uses LLM-as-a-judge to determine if the request matches a policy of allowed traffic for that agent. Agents need real credentials, but can hallucinate destructive actions or get prompt-injected. This can have production consequences. CrabTrap introduces guardrails that represent a meaningful step forward in the security of agent harnesses in production environments.

CrabTrap 是一个开源的 HTTP/HTTPS 代理，可拦截 AI 智能体（AI agent）发出的每一个请求，并使用 LLM-as-a-judge 来判断该请求是否符合为该智能体设定的允许流量策略。智能体需要真实凭证，但可能产生破坏性的幻觉行为或遭受提示注入（prompt-injected）攻击，这在生产环境中可能造成严重后果。CrabTrap 引入的防护栏（guardrails）代表了生产环境智能体安全领域的一次有意义进步。

Stitch's DESIGN.md format is now open-source so you can use it across platforms. (1 minute read)

Stitch's DESIGN.md lets users export or import design rules from project to project. Stitch understands the reasoning behind design systems and can generate user interfaces that match branches. Google has open sourced the draft specification for DESIGN.md, which can be used across any tool or platform. A video breaking down the format is available in the article.

Stitch 的 DESIGN.md 允许用户在不同项目之间导出或导入设计规则。Stitch 能够理解设计系统（design systems）背后的推理逻辑，并能生成与分支匹配的用户界面。Google 已开源 DESIGN.md 的草案规范，可在任何工具或平台中使用。文章中提供了详细解析该格式的视频。

OpenAI Is Working With Consultants to Sell Codex (3 minute read)

OpenAI is working with several consulting firms to help sell its AI coding tool Codex to businesses. Codex now has four million weekly active users, up from three million just two weeks ago. The Codex consulting program is part of OpenAI's push to focus on coding and enterprise businesses. Consulting partners will get access to an AI coding tool as part of the program.

OpenAI 正与多家咨询公司合作，向企业推销其 AI 编程工具 Codex。Codex 目前拥有 400 万周活跃用户，仅在两周前这个数字还是 300 万。Codex 咨询计划是 OpenAI 着力发展编程和企业业务的一部分。参与该计划的咨询合作伙伴将获得使用该 AI 编程工具的权限。

Sam Altman throws shade at Anthropic's cyber model, Mythos: 'fear-based marketing' (2 minute read)

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman called out Anthropic's new cybersecurity model during a podcast appearance this week, saying the company was using fear to make its product sound more impressive than it actually is. Anthropic announced its Mythos model earlier this month and only released it to a small cohort of enterprise customers with the claim that the model was too powerful to be released to the public as cybercriminals would weaponize it. Altman said that Anthropic's fear-based marketing was a good way to keep AI in the hands of a small and exclusive elite. Fear-based marketing is prevalent in the AI industry, and it has also come from Altman himself.

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 在本周的一档播客节目中公开批评 Anthropic 推出的网络安全模型，称该公司利用恐惧心理让其产品听起来比实际更强大。Anthropic 本月初发布了 Mythos 模型，仅向一小部分企业客户开放，并声称该模型过于强大，不宜向公众发布，否则网络犯罪分子会将其武器化。Altman 表示，Anthropic 的恐惧营销（fear-based marketing）是维持 AI 被少数精英垄断的好方法。恐惧营销在 AI 行业十分普遍，Altman 本人也曾使用过这种手段。

Build, Deploy, and Scale AI Infrastructure faster with Runpod (Sponsor)

Runpod is a GPU cloud developers use to launch pods, run inference, and autoscale on demand. Pay only for what you use.

Runpod 是一个 GPU 云（GPU cloud）平台，开发者可用其启动 pod、运行推理并按需自动扩展。只需按实际使用量付费。

TLDR is hiring a curator for TLDR AI (3-5 hrs/week, Fully Remote)

We're hiring an engineer/researcher at a major AI lab or startup to help write for 1M+ subscribers. Curators have been invited to Google I/O and OpenAI DevDay, scouted for Tier 1 VCs, and get early access to unreleased TLDR products.

.

我们正在招聘一名来自顶级 AI 实验室或初创公司的工程师/研究员，为超过 100 万订阅者撰写内容。策展人曾受邀参加 Google I/O 和 OpenAI DevDay，获得一级风投的关注，并能抢先体验尚未发布的 TLDR 产品。

.

Deep Research Max: a step change for autonomous research agents (6 minute read)

Google has introduced Deep Research and Deep Research Max, leveraging the Gemini 3.1 Pro model to enhance autonomous research capabilities.

Google 推出了 Deep Research 和 Deep Research Max，借助 Gemini 3.1 Pro 模型增强自主研究能力。

The fall of the theorem economy (63 minute read)

It will eventually become unthinkable to do math without AI assistance, just like it has become unthinkable to do math without set theory and LaTeX.

未来，不使用 AI 辅助（AI assistance）来做数学将是不可想象的，就像如今不使用集合论和 LaTeX 做数学一样不可想象。

Anthropics works on its always-on agent with UI extensions (3 minute read)

Anthropic's "Conway" is an always-on agent with UI extensions available on web and mobile, allowing users to manage connectors, install extensions, and configure the environment.

Anthropic 的 "Conway" 是一款支持 UI 扩展（UI extensions）的全天候智能体，可在网页和移动端使用，允许用户管理连接器、安装扩展并配置环境。

Agent World Training Arena (3 minute read)

Agent-World describes a self-evolving environment that generates tasks and feedback loops to continuously train and improve autonomous agents.

Agent-World 描述了一个自我进化的环境，该环境可生成任务和反馈循环，以持续训练和改进自主智能体。

What Claude Design is actually good for (and why Figma isn’t dead yet)

I import a full design system from Lenny’s Newsletter, build a landing page, turn my own article into a polished deck, generate a brand kit for ChatPRD, and run a personal color analysis from a photo.

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: Claude Code 将涨至每月100美元？恐怕不会，但这一切令人困惑
item.description:
标签: #Claude Code #Anthropic #定价 #AI编程

摘要: Anthropic 短暂测试将 Claude Code 从 20 美元/月的 Pro 计划移至 100 美元以上的 Max 计划，因缺乏官方沟通引发用户强烈不满与信任危机；尽管公司已回滚公开的定价页面改动，但作者认为此举已严重损害品牌信誉，并可能将普通用户推向更平价的竞品。

原标题: Is Claude Code going to cost $100/month? Probably not - it's all very confusing

Is Claude Code going to cost $100/month? Probably not - it's all very confusing

Claude Code 要涨到每月 100 美元了吗？大概率不会——但这整件事非常令人困惑

Anthropic today quietly (as in silently, no announcement anywhere at all) updated their claude.com/pricing page (but not their Choosing a Claude plan page, which shows up first for me on Google) to add this tiny but significant detail (arrow is mine, and it's already reverted):

今天，Anthropic 悄然（确切地说是悄无声息，没有任何公告）更新了其 claude.com/pricing 页面（但没有更新 Choosing a Claude plan 页面，该页面在 Google 搜索结果中对我排第一），添加了一个微小但重要的细节（箭头是我加的，而且页面已经恢复）：

The Internet Archive copy from yesterday shows a checkbox there. Claude Code used to be a feature of the $20/month Pro plan, but according to the new pricing page it is now exclusive to the $100/month or $200/month Max plans.

Internet Archive 昨天的存档副本显示那里是一个勾选框。Claude Code 曾是每月 20 美元 Pro 套餐的一项功能，但根据新的定价页面，它现在变成了每月 100 美元或 200 美元 Max 套餐独占。

Update: don't miss the update to this post, they've already changed course a few hours after this change went live.

更新：别错过本文的后续更新，这一改动上线仅几小时后，他们就已经改弦更张了。

So what the heck is going on? Unsurprisingly, Reddit and Hacker News and Twitter all caught fire.

所以到底是怎么回事？不出所料，Reddit、Hacker News 和 Twitter 全都炸开了锅。

I didn't believe the screenshots myself when I first saw them - aside from the pricing grid I could find no announcement from Anthropic anywhere. Then Amol Avasare, Anthropic's Head of Growth, tweeted:

我自己第一眼看到截图时也不相信——除了定价表格外，我在任何地方都找不到 Anthropic 的公告。随后，Amol Avasare，Anthropic 的增长负责人，发推称：

For clarity, we're running a small test on ~2% of new prosumer signups. Existing Pro and Max subscribers aren't affected.
澄清一下，我们正在对约 2% 的新 prosumer（专业消费者）注册用户进行小规模测试。现有 Pro 和 Max 订阅用户不受影响。
For clarity, we're running a small test on ~2% of new prosumer signups. Existing Pro and Max subscribers aren't affected.

澄清一下，我们正在对约 2% 的新 prosumer（专业消费者）注册用户进行小规模测试。现有 Pro 和 Max 订阅用户不受影响。

And that appears to be the closest we have had to official messaging from Anthropic.

而这似乎是我们能从 Anthropic 那里得到的最接近官方表态的说法了。

I don't buy the "~2% of new prosumer signups" thing, since everyone I've talked to is seeing the new pricing grid and the Internet Archive has already snapped a copy. Maybe he means that they'll only be running this version of the pricing grid for a limited time which somehow adds up to "2%" of signups?

我不买这个"约 2% 新 prosumer 注册用户"的账，因为我聊过的每个人都在看到新的定价表格，而且 Internet Archive 也已经抓取到了副本。也许他的意思是，他们只会在有限时间内运行这个版本的定价页面，而这个时间段里的注册用户加起来刚好占"2%"？

I'm also amused to see Claude Cowork remain available on the $20/month plan, because Claude Cowork is effectively a rebranded version of Claude Code wearing a less threatening hat!

我也觉得挺好笑的是，Claude Cowork 仍然保留在每月 20 美元的套餐中，因为 Claude Cowork 本质上就是换了个不那么吓人的帽子的 Claude Code 翻新版！

There are a whole bunch of things that are bad about this.

这件事有很多糟糕的地方。

If we assume this is indeed a test, and that test comes up negative and they decide not to go ahead with it, the damage has still been extensive:

如果我们假设这确实是一次测试，而且测试结果呈负面、他们决定不继续推进，伤害仍然已经造成了：

  • A whole lot of people got scared or angry or both that a service they relied on was about to be rug-pulled. There really is a significant difference between $20/month and $100/month for most people, especially outside of higher salary countries.
  • The uncertainty is really bad! A tweet from an employee is not the way to make an announcement like this. I wasted a solid hour of my afternoon trying to figure out what had happened here. My trust in Anthropic's transparency around pricing - a crucial factor in how I understand their products - has been shaken.
  • Strategically, should I be taking a bet on Claude Code if I know that they might 5x the minimum price of the product?
  • More of a personal issue, but one I care deeply about myself: I invest a great deal of effort (that's 105 posts and counting) in teaching people how to use Claude Code. I don't want to invest that effort in a product that most people cannot afford to use.
  • 很多人感到害怕、愤怒，或者两者兼有，因为他们依赖的服务即将被 rug-pulled（像抽地毯一样被突然抛弃）。对大多数人来说，每月 20 美元和每月 100 美元之间真的有显著差别，尤其是在高薪资国家以外的地区。
  • 不确定性真的很糟糕！一名员工的一条推文不是发布此类公告的合适方式。我浪费了整整一个下午试图搞清楚这里发生了什么。我对 Anthropic 在定价方面透明度的信任——这是我理解他们产品的关键因素（crucial factor）——已经动摇了。
  • 从策略上讲，如果我知道他们可能会将产品的最低价格提高 5 倍，我还应该押注 Claude Code 吗？
  • 更多是个人的问题，但我自己非常在意：我投入了大量精力（到目前为止已有 105 篇文章）来教人们如何使用 Claude Code。我不想把精力投入到一个大多数人都负担不起的产品上。
Last month I ran a tutorial for journalists on "Coding agents for data analysis" at the annual NICAR data journalism conference. I'm not going to be teaching that audience a course that depends on a $100/month subscription!

上个月，我在一年一度的 NICAR 数据新闻大会上为记者们举办了一场关于"Coding agents（编程智能体）用于数据分析"的教程。我不会教那个受众一门依赖于每月 100 美元订阅的课程！

This also doesn't make sense to me as a strategy for Anthropic. Claude Code defined the category of coding agents. It's responsible for billions of dollars in annual revenue for Anthropic already. It has a stellar reputation, but I'm not convinced that reputation is strong enough for it to lose the $20/month trial and jump people directly to a $100/month subscription.

作为 Anthropic 的策略，这也让我感到说不通。Claude Code 定义了 coding agents（编程智能体）这一品类。它已经为 Anthropic 带来了数十亿美元的年度收入。它拥有极佳的声誉，但我不认为这个声誉足够强大，可以让它放弃每月 20 美元的试用档位，直接把用户推到每月 100 美元的订阅。

OpenAI have been investing heavily in catching up to Claude Code with their Codex products. Anthropic just handed them this marketing opportunity on a plate - here's Codex engineering lead Thibault Sottiaux:

OpenAI 一直在投入重金，试图通过他们的 Codex 产品追上 Claude Code。Anthropic 刚把这次营销机会拱手相让——以下是 Codex 工程负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 的说法：

I don't know what they are doing over there, but Codex will continue to be available both in the FREE and PLUS ($20) plans. We have the compute and efficient models to support it. For important changes, we will engage with the community well ahead of making them.Transparency and trust are two principles we will not break, even if it means momentarily earning less. A reminder that you vote with your subscription for the values you want to see in this world.
我不知道他们那边在搞什么，但 Codex 将继续在 FREE 和 PLUS（20 美元）套餐中提供。我们有足够的 compute（计算资源/算力）和高效模型来支持它。对于重大变更，我们会在实施前充分与社区沟通。透明和信任是我们不会打破的两条原则，即使这意味着暂时少赚一点。提醒一下，你用订阅投票，选择你想在这个世界上看到的价值观。
I don't know what they are doing over there, but Codex will continue to be available both in the FREE and PLUS ($20) plans. We have the compute and efficient models to support it. For important changes, we will engage with the community well ahead of making them.

我不知道他们那边在搞什么，但 Codex 将继续在 FREE 和 PLUS（20 美元）套餐中提供。我们有足够的计算资源和高效模型来支持它。对于重大变更，我们会在实施前充分与社区沟通。

Transparency and trust are two principles we will not break, even if it means momentarily earning less. A reminder that you vote with your subscription for the values you want to see in this world.

透明和信任是我们不会打破的两条原则，即使这意味着暂时少赚一点。提醒一下，你用订阅投票，选择你想在这个世界上看到的价值观。

I should note that I pay $200/month for Claude Max and I consider it well worth the money. I've had periods of free access in the past courtesy of Anthropic but I'm currently paying full price, and happy to do so.

我应该说明，我自己每月支付 200 美元订阅 Claude Max，而且我觉得这笔钱花得很值。过去 Anthropic 曾给我提供免费使用的时段，但我目前正在全额付费，并且乐意如此。

But I care about the accessibility of the tools that I work with and teach. If Codex has a free tier while Claude Code starts at $100/month I should obviously switch to Codex, because that way I can use the same tool as the people I want to teach how to use coding agents.

但我关心我所使用和教授的工具的可及性（accessibility）。如果 Codex 有免费层级，而 Claude Code 起步价就是每月 100 美元，那我显然应该转向 Codex，因为这样我就能和我想要教授 coding agents（编程智能体）使用的人们使用同样的工具。

Here's what I think happened. I think Anthropic are trying to optimize revenue growth - obviously - and someone pitched making Claude Code only available for Max and higher. That's clearly a bad idea, but "testing" culture says that it's worth putting even bad ideas out to test just in case they surprise you.

以下是我认为发生的事情。我认为 Anthropic 正在试图优化收入增长——显然如此——于是有人提议让 Claude Code 仅对 Max 及以上套餐开放。这显然是个坏主意，但"测试"文化认为，哪怕坏主意也值得拿出去测试，万一结果出人意料呢。

So they started a test, without taking into account the wailing and gnashing of teeth that would result when their test was noticed - or accounting for the longer-term brand damage that would be caused.

于是他们启动了一项测试，却没有考虑到当测试被发现时会引发的哀号和切齿之痛——也没有考虑到这将造成的长期品牌损害。

Or maybe they did account for that, and decided it was worth the risk.

又或者他们确实考虑到了，但认为值得冒这个险。

I don't think that calculation was worthwhile. They're going to have to make a very firm commitment along the lines of "we heard your feedback and we commit to keeping Claude Code available on our $20/month plan going forward" to regain my trust.

我不认为这种算计是值得的。他们需要做出非常坚定的承诺，比如"我们听到了你们的反馈，并承诺未来将继续在每月 20 美元的套餐中提供 Claude Code"，才能重新赢得我的信任。

As it stands, Codex is looking like a much safer bet for me to invest my time in learning and building educational materials around.

就目前而言，Codex 看起来是一个安全得多的押注，值得我投入时间学习和围绕它制作教育材料。

Update: they've reversed it already

更新：他们已经撤销了这一改动

In the time I was typing this blog entry Anthropic appear to have reversed course - the claude.com/pricing page now has a checkbox back in the Pro column for Claude Code. I can't find any official communication about it though.

就在我打字写这篇博客的期间，Anthropic 似乎已经改变了方向——claude.com/pricing 页面的 Pro 列中，Claude Code 的勾选框又回来了。不过我找不到任何关于此事的官方沟通。

Let's see if they can come up with an explanation/apology that's convincing enough to offset the trust bonfire from this afternoon!

让我们看看他们能否拿出一个足够有说服力的解释/道歉，来抵消今天下午这场信任大火吧！

Update 2: it may still affect 2% of signups?

更新 2：它可能仍会影响 2% 的注册用户？

Amol on Twitter:

Amol 在 Twitter 上表示：

was a mistake that the logged-out landing page and docs were updated for this test [embedded self-tweet]Getting lots of questions on why the landing page / docs were updated if only 2% of new signups were affected.This was understandably confusing for the 98% of folks not part of the experiment, and we've reverted both the landing page and docs changes.
为这次测试更新了未登录着陆页和文档是一个错误 [嵌套的自引推文] 很多人问，如果只有 2% 的新注册用户受影响，为什么要更新着陆页/文档。对于 98% 不参与实验的人来说，这确实令人困惑，因此我们已经恢复了着陆页和文档的更改。
was a mistake that the logged-out landing page and docs were updated for this test [embedded self-tweet]

为这次测试更新了未登录着陆页和文档是一个错误 [嵌套的自引推文]

Getting lots of questions on why the landing page / docs were updated if only 2% of new signups were affected.This was understandably confusing for the 98% of folks not part of the experiment, and we've reverted both the landing page and docs changes.
很多人问，如果只有 2% 的新注册用户受影响，为什么要更新着陆页/文档。对于 98% 不参与实验的人来说，这确实令人困惑，因此我们已经恢复了着陆页和文档的更改。
Getting lots of questions on why the landing page / docs were updated if only 2% of new signups were affected.

很多人问，如果只有 2% 的新注册用户受影响，为什么要更新着陆页/文档。

This was understandably confusing for the 98% of folks not part of the experiment, and we've reverted both the landing page and docs changes.

对于 98% 不参与实验的人来说，这确实令人困惑，因此我们已经恢复了着陆页和文档的更改。

So the experiment is still running, just not visible to the rest of the world?

所以实验仍在运行，只是对世界其他地方不可见了？

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: GitHub Copilot 个人版计划调整
item.description:
标签: #AI编程 #定价调整 #编码代理

摘要: GitHub宣布收紧Copilot个人版使用限制并暂停新用户注册，将Claude Opus 4.7等高级模型限制在月费39美元的Pro+计划中。官方解释称，AI Agent工作流大幅推高了计算资源消耗，因此平台正从按请求计费转向基于token的会话限制，以维持服务可靠性。

原标题: Changes to GitHub Copilot Individual plans

Changes to GitHub Copilot Individual plans

GitHub Copilot 个人版计划变更

Unlike Anthropic, GitHub put up an official announcement about their changes, which include tightening usage limits, pausing signups for individual plans (!), restricting Claude Opus 4.7 to the more expensive $39/month "Pro+" plan, and dropping the previous Opus models entirely.

与 Anthropic 不同，GitHub 发布了一份官方公告，宣布了其变更内容，包括收紧使用限制、暂停个人版计划的新用户注册（！）、将 Claude Opus 4.7 限制在价格更高的每月 39 美元 "Pro+" 计划中，并完全下架了此前的 Opus 模型。

The key paragraph:

核心段落如下：

Agentic workflows have fundamentally changed Copilot’s compute demands. Long-running, parallelized sessions now regularly consume far more resources than the original plan structure was built to support. As Copilot’s agentic capabilities have expanded rapidly, agents are doing more work, and more customers are hitting usage limits designed to maintain service reliability.

Agentic workflows（智能体工作流）从根本上改变了 Copilot 的计算需求。长时间运行、并行化的会话现在消耗的资源，已远超最初计划架构所能支持的程度。随着 Copilot 智能体能力的快速扩展，agents（智能体）承担了更多工作，越来越多用户正触及旨在维持服务可靠性的 usage limits（使用上限）。

Agentic workflows have fundamentally changed Copilot’s compute demands. Long-running, parallelized sessions now regularly consume far more resources than the original plan structure was built to support. As Copilot’s agentic capabilities have expanded rapidly, agents are doing more work, and more customers are hitting usage limits designed to maintain service reliability.

Agentic workflows（智能体工作流）从根本上改变了 Copilot 的计算需求。长时间运行、并行化的会话现在消耗的资源，已远超最初计划架构所能支持的程度。随着 Copilot 智能体能力的快速扩展，agents（智能体）承担了更多工作，越来越多用户正触及旨在维持服务可靠性的 usage limits（使用上限）。

It’s easy to forget that just six months ago heavy LLM users were burning an order of magnitude less tokens. Coding agents consume alotof compute.

人们很容易忘记，就在六个月前，重度 LLM（大语言模型）用户消耗的 token 数量比现在低一个数量级。Coding agents（编程智能体）消耗大量算力。

Copilot was also unique (I believe) among agents in charging per-request, not per-token. (Correction: Windsurf also operated a credit system like this which theyabandoned last month.) This means that single agentic requests which burn more tokens cut directly into their margins. The most recent pricing scheme addresses that with token-based usage limits on a per-session and weekly basis.

据我所知，Copilot 在智能体中也是独树一帜，采用 per-request（按请求）而非 per-token（按 token）计费。（更正：Windsurf 此前也采用过类似的积分制度，但已于上月放弃。）这意味着单次消耗更多 token 的智能体请求会直接侵蚀其利润。最新的定价方案通过 token-based usage limits（基于 token 的使用限制）来解决这一问题，限制维度包括 per-session（按会话）和每周。

My one problem with this announcement is that it doesn’t clearly clarifywhichproduct called "GitHub Copilot" is affected by these changes. Last month inHow many products does Microsoft have named 'Copilot'? I mapped every oneTey Bannerman identified 75 products that share the Copilot brand, 15 of which have "GitHub Copilot" in the title.

我对这份公告的唯一不满是，它没有明确说明名为 "GitHub Copilot" 的哪款产品受到了这些变更的影响。在上个月那篇《How many products does Microsoft have named 'Copilot'? I mapped every one》中，Tey Bannerman 梳理出共有 75 款共享 Copilot 品牌的产品，其中 15 款在标题中包含 "GitHub Copilot"。

Judging by the linkedGitHub Copilot plans pagethis covers Copilot CLI, Copilot cloud agent and code review (features onGitHub.comitself), and the Copilot IDE features available in VS Code, Zed, JetBrains and more.

根据链接指向的 GitHub Copilot plans page，此次变更涵盖 Copilot CLI、Copilot cloud agent 和代码审查（GitHub.com 本身的功能），以及在 VS Code、Zed、JetBrains 等工具中可用的 Copilot IDE features（IDE 功能）。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: Bobby Holley：AI赋能安全的希望与决胜
item.description:
标签: #火狐 #AI安全 #漏洞修复

摘要: Mozilla与Anthropic合作，借助Claude Mythos Preview对Firefox进行安全评估，并在Firefox 150版本中修复了发现的271个漏洞。Firefox CTO Bobby Holley表示，这一成果令人鼓舞，证明只要团队专注投入，AI将帮助安全防御方 decisively 扭转战局。

原标题: Quoting Bobby Holley

Quoting Bobby Holley

As part of our continued collaboration with Anthropic, we had the opportunity to apply an early version of Claude Mythos Preview to Firefox. This week’s release of Firefox 150 includes fixes for271 vulnerabilitiesidentified during this initial evaluation. [...]

作为与 Anthropic 持续合作的一部分，我们有机会将早期版本的 Claude Mythos Preview 应用于 Firefox。本周发布的 Firefox 150 包含了在此次初步评估中发现的 271 个 vulnerabilities（漏洞） 修复。[...]

Our experience is a hopeful one for teams who shake off the vertigo and get to work. You may need to reprioritize everything else to bring relentless and single-minded focus to the task, but there is light at the end of the tunnel. We are extremely proud of how our team rose to meet this challenge, and others will too. Our work isn’t finished, but we’ve turned the corner and can glimpse a future much better than just keeping up.Defenders finally have a chance to win, decisively.

对于那些摆脱 眩晕感 并投入工作的团队来说，我们的经验是充满希望的。你可能需要重新确定其他一切事项的优先级，以便对该任务保持不懈且专注的投入，但隧道尽头终有光明。我们非常自豪于我们的团队如何挺身而出迎接这一挑战，其他团队也能做到。我们的工作尚未完成，但我们已经 扭转了局面，能够瞥见一个远比仅仅疲于应付更美好的未来。Defenders（防御者） 终于有机会果断地获胜。

As part of our continued collaboration with Anthropic, we had the opportunity to apply an early version of Claude Mythos Preview to Firefox. This week’s release of Firefox 150 includes fixes for271 vulnerabilitiesidentified during this initial evaluation. [...]

作为与 Anthropic 持续合作的一部分，我们有机会将早期版本的 Claude Mythos Preview 应用于 Firefox。本周发布的 Firefox 150 包含了在此次初步评估中发现的 271 个 vulnerabilities（漏洞） 修复。[...]

Our experience is a hopeful one for teams who shake off the vertigo and get to work. You may need to reprioritize everything else to bring relentless and single-minded focus to the task, but there is light at the end of the tunnel. We are extremely proud of how our team rose to meet this challenge, and others will too. Our work isn’t finished, but we’ve turned the corner and can glimpse a future much better than just keeping up.Defenders finally have a chance to win, decisively.

对于那些摆脱 眩晕感 并投入工作的团队来说，我们的经验是充满希望的。你可能需要重新确定其他一切事项的优先级，以便对该任务保持不懈且专注的投入，但隧道尽头终有光明。我们非常自豪于我们的团队如何挺身而出迎接这一挑战，其他团队也能做到。我们的工作尚未完成，但我们已经 扭转了局面，能够瞥见一个远比仅仅疲于应付更美好的未来。Defenders（防御者） 终于有机会果断地获胜。

—Bobby Holley, CTO, Firefox

——Bobby Holley，Firefox 首席技术官（CTO）

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: Qwen3.6-27B：27B稠密模型的旗舰级编程表现
item.description:
标签: #通义千问 #代码生成 #本地部署

摘要: Qwen3.6-27B 以仅27B参数的轻量稠密模型实现了旗舰级编码性能，全面超越上一代397B规模的MoE开源旗舰；该模型体积大幅缩减至55.6GB，可在本地以量化版本流畅运行，并能高质量完成复杂SVG生成等任务。

原标题: Qwen3.6-27B: Flagship-Level Coding in a 27B Dense Model

Qwen3.6-27B: Flagship-Level Coding in a 27B Dense Model

Qwen3.6-27B：27B 密集模型中的旗舰级编码能力

Qwen3.6-27B delivers flagship-level agentic coding performance, surpassing the previous-generation open-source flagship Qwen3.5-397B-A17B (397B total / 17B active MoE) across all major coding benchmarks.

Qwen3.6-27B 实现了旗舰级的 agentic coding（agentic 编码）性能，在所有主流编码基准测试中均超越了上一代开源旗舰模型 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B（总参数量 397B / 激活参数量 17B 的 MoE 模型）。

Qwen3.6-27B delivers flagship-level agentic coding performance, surpassing the previous-generation open-source flagship Qwen3.5-397B-A17B (397B total / 17B active MoE) across all major coding benchmarks.

Qwen3.6-27B 实现了旗舰级的 agentic coding（agentic 编码）性能，在所有主流编码基准测试中均超越了上一代开源旗舰模型 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B（总参数量 397B / 激活参数量 17B 的 MoE 模型）。

On Hugging FaceQwen3.5-397B-A17Bis 807GB, this newQwen3.6-27Bis 55.6GB.

在 Hugging Face 上，Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 的体积为 807GB，而新款 Qwen3.6-27B 仅为 55.6GB。

I tried it out with the 16.8GB UnslothQwen3.6-27B-GGUF:Q4_K_Mquantized version andllama-serverusing this recipe bybenob on Hacker News, after first installingllama-serverusingbrew install llama.cpp:

我使用了 16.8GB 的 Unsloth Qwen3.6-27B-GGUF Q4_K_M 量化版本和 llama-server 进行了测试，配置参考了 Hacker News 上 benob 分享的方案。在此之前，我先通过 brew install llama.cpp 安装了 llama-server： 

llama-server \
    -hf unsloth/Qwen3.6-27B-GGUF:Q4_K_M \
    --no-mmproj \
    --fit on \
    -np 1 \
    -c 65536 \
    --cache-ram 4096 -ctxcp 2 \
    --jinja \
    --temp 0.6 \
    --top-p 0.95 \
    --top-k 20 \
    --min-p 0.0 \
    --presence-penalty 0.0 \
    --repeat-penalty 1.0 \
    --reasoning on \
    --chat-template-kwargs '{"preserve_thinking": true}'
On first run that saved the ~17GB model to~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--unsloth--Qwen3.6-27B-GGUF.

首次运行后，这个约 17GB 的模型被保存到了 ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--unsloth--Qwen3.6-27B-GGUF。

Here'sthe transcriptfor "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle". This is anoutstandingresult for a 16.8GB local model:

以下是生成“一只鹈鹕骑自行车的 SVG”的对话记录。对于一个 16.8GB 的本地模型来说，这个结果非常出色：

Performance numbers reported byllama-server:

llama-server 报告的性能数据：

  • Reading: 20 tokens, 0.4s, 54.32 tokens/s
  • Generation: 4,444 tokens, 2min 53s, 25.57 tokens/s

- 读取：20 个 token，0.4 秒，54.32 token/秒
- 生成：4,444 个 token，2 分 53 秒，25.57 token/秒

For good measure, here'sGenerate an SVG of a NORTH VIRGINIA OPOSSUM ON AN E-SCOOTER(run previouslywith GLM-5.1):

作为补充，这里还有生成“一只北弗吉尼亚负鼠骑电动滑板车（NORTH VIRGINIA OPOSSUM ON AN E-SCOOTER）”的 SVG 的测试（此前曾用 GLM-5.1 运行过）：

That one took 6,575 tokens, 4min 25s, 24.74 t/s.

这次生成消耗了 6,575 个 token，耗时 4 分 25 秒，速度为 24.74 token/秒。
